description: Source file implementing fusion kernel registration, management, and compilation functions for PyTorch JIT code generation, including backend registration, kernel compilation, and graph analysis.

methods.name: registerFusionBackend
methods.description: Registers a fusion backend for a specific device type.

methods.name: hasFusionBackend
methods.description: Checks if a fusion backend exists for a given device type.

methods.name: getConstructor
methods.description: Retrieves the constructor for a specific fusion backend.

methods.name: nCompiledKernels
methods.description: Returns the number of kernels compiled.

methods.name: debugFuser
methods.description: Returns the current debug level for fusion.

methods.name: usedInFusedChunk
methods.description: Checks if a node is used in a fused chunk.

methods.name: setInputChunkDescriptors
methods.description: Sets chunk descriptors for kernel specification based on graph inputs.

methods.name: getInputDependencies
methods.description: Performs DFS to find input dependencies affecting an output.

methods.name: setInputBroadcastGroups
methods.description: Sets broadcast groups for kernel inputs based on graph outputs.

methods.name: upfrontCompilation
methods.description: Performs upfront compilation to identify tensor expansion and broadcast groups.

methods.name: registerFusion
methods.description: Registers a fusion group and returns its key.

methods.name: compileKernel
methods.description: Compiles a kernel from a fusion specification, graph, and device.
